artisan.wiki_wording: Artisan Goods will be worth 40% more (with the exception of Oil and Coffee).

professions.rounding_note: Rancher and Artisan prices in the wiki infoboxes equal floor(base x multiplier); the importer checks this for every normal-quality price above.

feeding.eats_hay_when: All Coop-dwelling and Barn-dwelling Animals eat 1 Hay per day as food whenever there is no fresh Grass available.
feeding.stays_inside: They will not go out in winter, or when it is rainy, stormy, or snowy.
feeding.grass_portion: If eating fresh grass, coop animals need to eat 2 tufts of grass (1 tuft of Blue Grass), and barn animals need to eat 4 (2 tufts of Blue Grass).
feeding.unfed: They do not die if not fed, but become upset and cease production of animal products until feeding resumes.
feeding.babies: If they don't have food, they do not grow on that day.
feeding.autofeed: The Deluxe Coop features an Autofeed System; hay from your silos will be automatically distributed.
production_rules: If the animal was not fed, it will not produce.
If the animal has less than 70 Mood, there is a chance it will not produce. The lower the mood, the less likely it will produce. The percent chance it will still produce is equal to Mood / 70.

order: If it is, the score divided by 2 will be compared against a random number between 0-1. If the score divided by 2 is greater than the random number, the item will be Iridium quality.

If an Iridium quality item is not produced, the score divided by 2 will be compared against a random number between 0-1. If the score divided by 2 is greater than the random number, the item will be Gold quality.
If a Gold quality item is not produced, the score will be compared against a random number between 0-1. If it is greater than the random number, the item will be Silver quality.
quality.requires: If the animal has the ability to produce a Quality item (150 mood or higher), it will roll for quality from normal to iridium.
quality.truffle_note: Collection will be affected by Foraging skill, allowing the player to gather iridium quality Truffles with a chance of double harvest.

wiki_wording: If Mood is more than 200, it will be multiplied by 1.5
If Mood is 100 or less, then "Mood Modifier" will be the animal's mood minus 100 (This will always result in a negative or zero modifier)
Otherwise "Mood Modifier" is Zero (Mood is higher than 100, and up to 200)

deluxe_rules.ability: If an animal is below 150 Mood, it still has a chance to have the ability to produce Quality and Large or Deluxe products. The lower the mood, the less likely. The percent chance to gain the ability is equal to Mood / 150.
deluxe_rules.roll: Each time a product is rolled, a number between 0-1 is chosen randomly. If the overall score is higher than the random number, a Large product will be created.
deluxe_rules.stated_maximum: At max Friendship, Mood, and Luck, there is a 40% chance of getting a Rabbit's Foot and a 42% chance of getting a Duck Feather.

animals.name: Chicken

notes: Animals who can produce a Deluxe/Large product will sometimes produce more frequently, however — In this case, animals that normally would take multiple days to produce, will produce again immediately the next day.

large_product.wiki_wording: Once sufficient friendship and happiness is reached, it has a chance to produce a Large Egg or Large Brown Egg which sells for 95g.

notes: After seeing Shane's 8-heart event, each chicken you purchase from Marnie has a 25% chance of being blue.
Aside from appearance, blue chickens are identical to regular white and brown chickens.

White and blue chickens produce white eggs, and brown chickens produce brown eggs, so it makes a difference in completing the Community Center Bundles, especially if Remixed Bundles is not chosen at start of game.

notes: Ducks are unique in that if they swim on water, such as on the Farm Pond, Riverland or Beach Farms, they do not need to eat hay or grass to be fed overnight.

acquisition.wiki_wording: Void Chickens can be hatched by placing a Void Egg into an Incubator, taking 9,000m (5d 16h 40m) to incubate, or 4,500m (2d 21h 40m) with the Coopmaster Profession. There is no other way to obtain a Void Chicken.

notes: The Animals page gives the interval once for its whole "Chickens" section ("Adult chickens will produce eggs every morning if fed."), which also lists the Void Chicken.

acquisition.wiki_wording: Golden Chickens can be hatched by placing a Golden Egg into an Incubator, taking 9,000m (5d 16h 40m) to incubate, or 4,500m (2d 21h 40m) with the Coopmaster Profession.

egg.requirement: To obtain Golden Eggs and Golden Chickens, Perfection must be reached.

notes: The Animals page gives the interval once for its whole "Chickens" section ("Adult chickens will produce eggs every morning if fed."), which also lists the Golden Chicken.

animals.name: Dinosaur

acquisition.wiki_wording: Dinosaurs can be hatched by placing a Dinosaur Egg into an Incubator, taking 18,000m (11d 6h 40m) to incubate, or 9,000m (5d 16h 40m) with the Coopmaster Profession.

notes: Dinosaurs are born mature.
If you have used the Treasure Appraisal Guide the egg instead sells for 1050g.

notes: A mature sheep grows in its coat every 3 days, if it is fed and has at least 70 happiness.
If the player has 900 or more Friendship with the sheep and has pet it at least one time, it will reduce it to every other day.

conditions: the pig has been let outside the barn
there are tiles available outside upon which to place a truffle
produce.first_truffle: This means that there is around a 99.99% chance that a pig will generate a truffle each day, with the assumption that it is walking around on mostly free tiles.
produce.extra_truffle_note: This means that at max friendship (1000), there is a 66% chance of creating an extra truffle.
produce.average_note: The average number of truffles a pig at max happiness produces in a day is ≈3
notes: Truffles that are not gathered will stay on the ground until the next day.
truffles that are not gathered on the 28th day of a season disappear on the following morning (the 1st day of the new season).
Pigs have a 0.2% chance to dig up a Truffle Crab instead of a Truffle.
A Golden Animal Cracker can be given to any farm animal (except pigs) to permanently double its produce.
